question: Estimate the reach of a Spotify audio ad campaign in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Spotify Free tier listeners (where audio ads play)? Yes — only free tier.
All India English + Bollywood + regional listeners? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Budget / CPM = impressions; impressions / frequency = reach.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Spotify India free-tier listeners: ~52 million MAU (out of 57M; 4-5M paid).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Unique reach: 30 lakh / 4.5 = ~6.5-7 lakh unique listeners.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Audio ad CPM on Spotify India
Average frequency for audio ads (heavy users hear repeats)

calculationFlow: Spotify India free-tier listeners: ~52 million MAU (out of 57M; 4-5M paid).
Audio ad CPM on Spotify India: ~₹40-60.
Unique reach: 30 lakh / 4.5 = ~6.5-7 lakh unique listeners.
